body: Q85 done: five playback mechanics measured and committed on qwen/q85-playback-mechanics. custom_speed does not stretch blends (0.25s blend stays 0.25s at 0.5x speed), queue() blends with no freeze frames, set_blend_time overrides default, outgoing clips hold last frame mid-blend with no jump, animation_finished fires under advance() at clip end. All answers re-derived from series, gate passes.
